_README: Companies that have asked not to be contacted again, plus Harry's own
employer. Nothing in this repo may write to them - not an application, not
a follow-up, not a speculative note, not a reply. Enforced in send_email(),
which every outgoing message goes through, so a new stage cannot forget to
Match on any of: 'name' (against the company name on a listing), 'domain'
(the address's domain and any subdomain), 'emails' (exact). A domain is the
strongest entry - it covers addresses nobody has seen yet.
Set 'match' to 'exact' when the name is generic. company_key() strips words
like 'group' and 'limited', so 'Hydro Group' becomes 'hydro', and without
this it would also block Hydro Cleansing and Hydro Systems.
Add an entry the day somebody asks. Removing one needs them to say so.
